concept: Snow Family: offline transfer of hundreds of TB over a thin link
tests: Choosing how to move petabyte-scale data when network transfer would take months.
expected: AWS Snowball / Snow Family: physical devices for encrypted offline transfer of petabytes. Triggers: "10 PB", "network would take months", "physical bulk transfer appliance".
why_not: DataSync and direct S3 upload are limited by network bandwidth; Storage Gateway is hybrid access, not a one-time 10 PB migration.
